data._stale_nav_note: Team lead 2026-10-13 (redesign; report mode first, `on` after a measured week). WHAT: the decide-time stale-NAV gate, quantt/session/nav_gate.py. Yahoo serves a NAV row dated D that carries an older NAV; gate 5 checks only the date (results/cef/LIVE_NAV_QUALITY_2026-10-12.md section 5: 28 of 73 checkable laptop name-days decided on NAV(D-1), 11 orders sized on one). A name whose NAV(D) equals its previous NAV, or CEFConnect's NAV(D-1), is checked against CEFConnect's D: different -> replaced through the logged fallback; equal -> kept; no row or an error -> the decide is deferred to the morning backstop, and from the final check (close - 90 min) the name keeps its current shares, out of the cross-section, never targeted to zero, never the min_names flatten. MODES: absent = off; report = every check and what `on` would do is recorded in plan.json (nav_gate) and <state>/nav_gate.csv, and NOTHING else changes; on = applied. NO-OP PROOF for report: quantt/session/tests/test_nav_gate.py, test_real_sleeve_on_the_real_panel_report_mode_is_byte_identical (live spec, real sleeve, real panel as of 2026-09-25, a held book that trades: same exit, orders, plan_sha and plan.json apart from nav_gate) and test_report_mode_leaves_the_orders_and_the_plan_unchanged (an evening where `on` would defer). CONSEQUENCE accepted: report mode reads CEFConnect once per deployed name at each decide (13 requests); an error there is recorded as UNMEASURED and never stops the session. NOT CHOSEN: `on` now -- the replay (docs/REFERENCES.md section 12s) rests on one week of laptop sessions and on three readings of when CEFConnect publishes D, which the collector now measures. READ BY: quantt/session/run.py stale_nav_for. REVERT: delete this `data` block (the session runs exactly as before the gate). Turning it `on` is another reviewed edit of this key.
data._missing_nav_note: Team lead 2026-10-29. WHAT: gate 5's missing-NAV hold, quantt/session/gate.py missing_nav_hold. On 2026-10-22 PDO's NAV for the as-of 2026-10-21 never reached the panel (fetch_daily exit 4 on every slot; its CEFConnect fallback has failed with JSONDecodeError since 2026-10-21), gate 5 refused all 13 names, and the book missed the day. RULE: a name whose only fault is a NAV not dated the as-of date DEFERS the decide before the final check (close - 90 min, 14:30 ET: the evening slots and the morning slots before it refuse with today's gate-5 refusals plus a deferral line, and the next slot retries); from the final check it is HELD: current shares, no order, out of the cross-section (the stale-NAV gate's nav_hold extra), never targeted to zero, never the cause of the sleeve's min_names flatten; the other names decide. AGE LIMIT (missing_nav_max_sessions): the team lead's POLICY of 2026-10-29, 2 consecutive sessions, NOT derived: PDO's 10-22 gap was one session, so a late NAV can arrive the next day. At the final check of the session after the limit, the fund's NAV still not dated as-of, gate 5 refuses the whole day exactly as without the key, naming the fund and how long it was held. The count is re-read at every final check from the prior sessions' plan.json (quantt/session/run.py missing_nav_streaks); a dated NAV resets it; a missing or unreadable record refuses the day, never counts as zero. Required with missing_nav; a positive int, else the runner raises. Not derived because prod's NAV panel (copy of 2026-10-28) shows 0 gaps in 12 months: the vendor backfills dates, and late NAVs show only as repeated values. REVIEW the limit against the live gaps in the run records' nav_dates (from about 2026-10-14) once a few months exist. STILL REFUSED as before: a missing or stale close, a name with no NAV at all, a refresh failure other than exit 4, and more missing NAVs than n - min_names from the frozen spec (13 - 6 = 7; past it the sleeve could trade no name on its signal: a broken feed, not a late NAV). VALUES: absent = gate 5 refuses the day on one missing NAV (before this key); hold = the rule. NO-OP PROOF: quantt/session/tests/test_missing_nav_hold.py, test_synthetic_key_absent_is_bd87144 and test_real_panel_key_absent_is_bd87144 (hashes computed by bd87144's code: exit, plan.json, plan_sha, orders, targets, run record, nav_gate.csv, send.json and what was sent, on a complete day and on a day with one as-of NAV missing at the evening decide and at the final check). REPLAY: the 2026-10-22 14:30 ET slot on prod's panel: PDO held (not opened), the other 12 decided, 4 orders. RECORDS: plan.json and the run record `missing_nav` (action, why, each missing name's last NAV date, max_sessions, held_before, what was held); one MISSING NAV log line. NOT CHOSEN: holding from the evening decide (the NAV may still land; the final check is the stale-NAV gate's); a fixed fraction (the name limit is derived from the spec's min_names). Single-sleeve book only: with risk_budget sleeves the key fails the session. READ BY: quantt/session/run.py missing_nav_for and missing_nav_max_sessions_for. REVERT: delete these three keys (the data block stays for stale_nav).

risk._drawdown_note: Team lead 2026-10-19 (HALVE/KILL in report mode). WHAT: at every decide the runner measures the book's drawdown from its high-water mark on <state>/eod_equity.csv -- Alpaca's end-of-day portfolio history (1D), the OFFICIAL daily P&L (team lead 2026-10-19), read by header name (date, equity) -- and compares it with the frozen spec's risk.halve_drawdown and risk.kill_drawdown (fractions, units-checked, read through run.py's load_spec, never a literal), quantt/session/drawdown.py. Until this, no code read either line and the runner never called risk_check (results/cef/PORTFOLIO_FRAMEWORK_2026-10-15.md section 1 item 4; re-verified at 832aeaa). MODES: absent = off; report = the status (OK, HALVE, KILL or UNMEASURED) and what an acting mode WOULD do are recorded in plan.json and the run record (`drawdown`) and printed as one DRAWDOWN line, and NOTHING else changes; an acting mode is NOT BUILT and setting one raises (run.drawdown_for). SERIES: eod_equity.csv absent or unreadable is UNMEASURED naming the file, never a fallback to equity.csv, whose after-hours snapshots can set a high-water mark the book never closed at (shown as a second, labelled line only). The newest row must be the as-of date, else UNMEASURED with the stale figures labelled. NO-OP PROOF for report: quantt/session/tests/test_drawdown.py, test_real_sleeve_on_the_real_panel_report_mode_is_byte_identical (live spec, real sleeve, real panel as of 2026-09-25, a held book that trades, the series at OK, HALVE-deep, KILL-deep and absent: same exit, orders, plan_sha, and plan.json byte-identical once `drawdown` is removed) and test_report_mode_records_the_check_and_leaves_the_orders_and_plan_identical. CONSEQUENCE accepted: until the collector release that writes eod_equity.csv is installed, every decide records UNMEASURED; that is the truth, and report mode never blocks. NOT CHOSEN: arming now (the team lead ruled report first); a frozen-spec switch (the levels are already the spec's; whether the runner acts on them is a runner setting, like data.stale_nav); equity.csv as the series (snapshots, above). READ BY: quantt/session/run.py drawdown_for and _drawdown. REVERT: delete this `risk` block (the session runs exactly as before). An acting mode is new code, a test that fails without it, and another reviewed edit of this key.

corporate_actions._mode_report_note: Team lead 2026-11-02: REPORT, not halt, for this release only. The gate's release-check on 3478159 found that today's real feed carries three market-wide rows with a missing party symbol (a partial call, an SNTI spin-off, a JAGX merger). Under the 2026-11-02 unresolved-rows ruling each one halts for every held fund, so halt would refuse the next session until each row is acked. The team lead ruled the same evening that CEF trial 53 ships tonight regardless, with the gate in report mode (docs/SYSTEM.md section 5). Report mode records every event, prints it and sends anyway; a failed read is recorded as UNMEASURED, never as clear. RESTORE: set mode back to "halt" in the next release, once the unresolved-row policy has been re-ruled on these three real rows.
corporate_actions._note: Team lead 2026-10-28 (a HALT guard for the paper runner). WHY: Alpaca paper processes no corporate actions, no splits and no mergers (two Alpaca staff forum replies, docs/REFERENCES.md section 12pc), and IBKR paper none either, so paper stays on Alpaca. The runner reads broker share counts as they are; a held fund that reverse-splits 1:4 keeps its old count on paper at four times the price, and the plan and its orders are sized on the wrong exposure. WHAT: at every decide, and again at the late-market send on fresh reads, the runner reads Alpaca's non-dividend corporate actions (reverse/forward/unit split, stock dividend, spin-off, cash/stock/stock-and-cash merger, redemption, name change, worthless removal, reorganization, partial call) for every held and targeted name, in any role (an acquirer included), with data_quality=all, and keeps those inside the window the role and match call for (quantt/session/corp_actions.py, THE WINDOW and TWO WINDOWS). LONG: a held name from the NYSE trading day before its last fill's submission (the latest close that fill was sized on, from the account's own order history) or the as-of date if earlier, a target-only name from the as-of date, both through the session date, for a market-date match as acquiree, split, stock dividend, spin-off, reorganization, name change, redemption, worthless removal or partial call. SHORT, (as-of, session], one session (team lead 2026-10-29): a merger acquirer in any of the three merger types and (re-review 2026-10-29) a reorganization's allocated leg, both on the market date only, and any other match through the process date alone (the real feed backfills actions years old). MODES: absent = no gate, today's behaviour; report = record in plan.json, the run record and send.json, print, and send anyway, with a failed read recorded as UNMEASURED, never as clear; halt = refuse the session through the existing refusal path (a gate-5 data refusal, exit 11 REFUSED, nothing sent) naming each event, and refuse too when the read fails or cannot be parsed, naming the error. NO-OP PROOF for absent and report: quantt/session/tests/test_corp_actions.py, test_the_key_absent_reads_nothing_and_records_nothing and test_report_changes_nothing_that_trades (report against absent with a blocking event: same exit, same orders sent, plan.json identical once corporate_actions is removed); the existing session suite passes unchanged. CONSEQUENCE accepted: a short-window halt clears by itself after one session; a long-window halt does not. While it refuses, nothing trades and the window keeps the event; it clears when the name's shares are set again after the event, by a filled order submitted on the second trading day after the event's latest date or later (an order on the first trading day after is sized on the event's own close and does not clear it; through the team lead, CLAUDE.md order-path rule 1), or when this mode is set to report. docs/RUNBOOK.md section 6.1 is the procedure, including the phantom P&L paper keeps. verify reads a refused day as MISSED (a FAIL), on purpose. Every decide and every send reads the whole closed-order history and the market's non-dividend actions over the padded window (a few pages); at the send one read that exhausts its retries takes about 250 s of the 360 s window, so the send is refused for time (docs/RUNNER.md, Latency at the send). NOT CHOSEN: report first (the team lead ruled halt); a server-side symbols filter (the reference does not say which field it matches on a merger, so a held acquirer could be dropped in silence); a window of the as-of and session dates only (Alpaca lists mergers late, so an action could slide out of view while the paper count stays wrong); rights distributions (no share count changes; paper credits no distributions either). READ BY: quantt/session/run.py corporate_actions_for and _corporate_actions. REVERT: delete this block (the session runs exactly as before the gate).
